entries.title: Route Clearance Envelope
entries.summary: Keep route-clearance claims bounded to measured widths, choke points, and obstruction visibility. Do not infer safe autonomous passage from partial captures.
entries.applicability: Use when route width, aisle clearance, or shared-lane access is under review.

entries.title: Workcell Hidden-Zone Review
entries.summary: If hidden zones or restricted views remain material, keep readiness at risky or not_ready_yet until a human confirms coverage or authorizes recapture.
entries.applicability: Use when hidden-zone bounds, privacy restrictions, or occluded workcells appear in evidence.

entries.title: Shared Human-Robot Space Risk
entries.summary: Shared pedestrian traffic, forklifts, and non-routine site behaviors require explicit human review and should not be auto-cleared by geometry alone.
entries.applicability: Use for active industrial aisles, docks, cells, and workcells with mixed traffic.

entries.title: Capture Evidence Sufficiency
entries.summary: Video-only capture can support pre-screening and blocker discovery, but decision-grade readiness requires structured intake and bounded metric evidence.
entries.applicability: Use when intake, QA, or metric scaffolding is incomplete.

entries.title: Humanoid Reach Envelope
entries.summary: Reach and manipulation claims must stay bounded to measured target distance, workcell span, and confirmed task-zone geometry.
entries.applicability: Use when task targets or articulated objects drive the qualification decision.

entries.title: Industrial Blocker Taxonomy
entries.summary: Every blocker should map to a concrete category with evidence references so humans can decide whether to recapture, redesign scope, or stop evaluation.
entries.applicability: Use whenever blocker register entries need normalization or escalation routing.
